title: Shared Pet Profiles plugin for Clinic and Shelter
summary: Pet Profiles is now one shared plugin used by Pet Care Clinic and Shelter and Rescue. Staff keep the same /pets URLs and permissions while Cases and Consultations use a small public Pet Profiles API for pet pickers.
changes: Move Pet Profiles model, policy, photo handling, dashboard providers, and views into plugins/pet-profiles.
Replace the dual Shelter and Pet Care controllers with one ModuleContext-driven controller and view set.
Keep live /shelter/pets and /petcare/pets routes, legacy pet-profiles redirects, and permission strings unchanged.
Expose PetProfilesContract so Cases and Consultations select pets through the plugin public API.
Point the pet_profile morph alias at the plugin model namespace.
version_rationale: Patch on v0.37.x: Structure Wave 5 moves Pet Profiles into a shared plugin without live URL or permission-string renames.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify / CI before merge; Cloudron workflow_dispatch with app_version from VERSION after merge.
known_limitations: Tickets, Cases, Recruitment, and Consultations plugin packages are still stubs; their controllers remain under App until Waves 6–7.
Historical pet_profiles migration stays in database/migrations for forward-only discoverability.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. No database migration runs in this release; rolling back application code restores the dual App controllers and App\\Models\\PetProfile namespace.
provenance: Structure Wave 5 Pet Profiles shared plugin #291 via pull request #308.
